_about: Settings for the vault tools. language: en | tr. names: English base name -> name in this install, as two tables (folders, files); empty in an English install, filled by the installer from locales/<lang>/names.json. context: the hook that adds related vault notes to each prompt (search.py --hook); mode: normal | economy | off. Change it here when the user asks to switch to economy mode or to turn automatic context off. dashboard.url: address of the user's claude.ai dashboard; empty until the first /dashboard run writes it (dashboard_check.py set-url).

prices._source: Claude API reference skill (claude-api, price table cache 2026-10-06; cache read and write multipliers in shared/prompt-caching.md). USD per million tokens. Cache write: input price x 1.25 (5 min) or x 2 (1 hour), applied in cost.py. Haiku has no separate cache read price, so the general rule (0.1 x input) is used.

context_window._why: Compact when the context reaches 65-70%; before that, unfinished work and what was discussed are written to the vault (context_check.py).
context_window._window_source: Claude Code 2.1.295 model table (context.window) and the context seen in transcripts; a model missing from the table counts as 200,000 (warns early, the safe side); if the seen context goes beyond that, 1,000,000
